identity.name: Prothom Alo
identity.description: Bangladesh's largest Bengali-language daily, with an English digital edition covering national politics, business, society and South Asian affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by Mediastar Limited, the media arm of Transcom Group. The group is one of Bangladesh's largest conglomerates, creating potential commercial and political entanglements despite a strong independent editorial reputation.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Established record of critical reporting on Bangladeshi governments and investigations, although ownership by a large conglomerate creates structural commercial pressures.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No MBFC rating; self-assessed as broadly centrist with a liberal, professional news agenda and space for opposition and civil-society voices.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is substantial but not uniformly pro-market; reporting spans corporate, labour and development perspectives.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: National lens with strong coverage of Bangladesh's politics and its South Asian neighbourhood.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Long-established newspaper of record with professional reporting and corrections; no MBFC rating identified.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for Prothom Alo in this review.

intelligence.knownPerspective: A Bangladeshi national newspaper of record. It frames events through domestic politics, development, business and South Asian regional dynamics, with an English edition aimed at international readers.

selectionRationale: Provides essential Bangladeshi national coverage and a South Asian perspective missing from the existing Daily Star/Dhaka Tribune pair.

research.researchNotes: Ownership established through Transcom/Mediastar references and Wikipedia; official English About page returned 404. Profile is DRAFT pending human verification and article sampling. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
